page.layout: Running head at top centre, page number at top left. Main text: one column of consul names in ruled rows, with year numbers in the right margin and notes in the left margin. Catchword at the bottom right.

main_text.l: Fœdus civitatis Groning. cū Dren-tinis de pace fir-manda.Ludolphus Sickinga.1292
Frisij ad Occid. Flevi ab Hollando subacti, & Hollan-diæ additi.Gerardus Huginge.1299

page.notes: The right margin numbers are years (1289–1299), each set beside its row. The rows 1289, 1291, 1293 to 1297 hold no names, or only a rule. "Burgemeisters" is set in black letter; the reading is uncertain. The left-margin notes are split across their rows. The printed "FrisiaGeldro" is run together in the scan and may be "Frisia Geldro". The bottom-right "Gerdt" is a catchword.
